title: fix(spec)!: refuse an object that declares one action name twice; Studio renames to a free name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9P9QpYQKquVrFuRFUPNpZf)_
Fixes #26725

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — the refusal itself names the action, every index and the fix at every door that parses an object, and no `skills/**` file teaches a shape that repeats an action name (`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` says nothing about name uniqueness either way)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:对象的 `actions` 数组里同名的两个动作,现在在对象 schema 解析时就被拒绝(保存门返回 422 `INVALID_METADATA`,指出重名和每个下标);Studio 动作面板里把动作改名成已占用的名字时,自动写成第一个空闲的 `NAME_N`。
- 为什么改:动作名是动作在对象上的运行键,之前保存门和发布门都接受同名的两个动作(实测保存 200、发布 200、两个都被服务),到底跑哪个是未定义的;Studio 的名称输入框会直接写出这种重名。
- 风险与回滚:这是一次收窄(BREAKING),已存的重名对象仍能加载,但带 `[metadata_spec_invalid]` 诊断,下次保存被拒;`os migrate meta --stored` 会按对象列出它们。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/data/duplicate-action-names.ts`(唯一判定与文案)、`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` 的 `refuseDuplicateActionNames`、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectActionsPanel.tsx` 的 `patchSelected` 改名分支。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/object-duplicate-action-name.test.ts`,预期 7 个用例全绿,其中重名用例断言路径 `actions.1` 与首句 "Object 'probe_item' declares the action 'dup' twice in actions: actions[0] and actions[1]."
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Spec (`@objectstack/spec`, minor, BREAKING).** `ObjectSchema`'s existing `superRefine` gains `refuseDuplicateActionNames`: one `custom` issue per repeated action name, at `actions[j]` of its second declaration, naming the name and every index (`Object 'X' declares the action 'Y' twice in actions: actions[i] and actions[j]. …`). The predicate and message live in one module, `data/duplicate-action-names.ts`, read by the refinement and by the v18 stored-row listing. No new check node, so the JSON Schema projection is unchanged (`dropped-refinements` baseline untouched; spec build green).
- **One judge per pair.** `defineStack`'s duplicate action-key check already refused two embedded twins on one object; on the strict path the object parse now refuses them first (`STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID`), so the cross-reference walk keeps the pairs that span two collections (bound standalone + embedded, two standalones). Its docblock says so; row (d) of `stack-duplicate-action-key.test.ts` and the "identical copy beside a differing twin" case now assert the parse envelope (`code`, `status`, first sentence).
- **ADR-0087: registered.** New D3 semantic entry `object-duplicate-action-name-refused` (step 18) and a `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` detector, so `os migrate meta --stored` lists each stored object that repeats a name, under its row, at `objects[0].actions[j]`. Nothing rewrites it: which declaration keeps the name only the owner knows. The listing's `from` carries only the name and the indexes (an action body can carry request headers).
- **Studio (`@object-ui/app-shell`, patch).** The actions panel's create path already derived a free name (`nextActionName`). The duplicate came from the editor's Name field, which wrote whatever was typed, so the QA run's three `call_api` entries were renames. `patchSelected` now writes a rename to a name another listed action holds as the first free `NAME_N`, and selects it.
- **Out of scope, by design.** A standalone `action` item bound to the object by `objectName` is a second item: one stack's pair stays `defineStack`'s duplicate-key refusal, and two packages' pair stays the runtime's bound-action collision report, which its own card ruled report-first (warn, not refuse). The object schema sees only its own array.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/data/object-duplicate-action-name.test.ts` (new): pair, three-way, one issue per name, byte-identical twin, distinct-name control, stored-body reads.
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts`: the new id in the registered list; a stored row with a pair is listed once at `objects[0].actions[1]`, not rewritten, and still fails the parse at the same site; distinct names are not listed.
- `packages/spec/src/stack-duplicate-action-key.test.ts`: rows above move to the parse envelope.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.object-duplicate-action-name-refusal.test.ts` (new): `saveMetaItem` answers `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 with one issue at `actions.1`, stores nothing; distinct-name control saves. `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` learned its doubles (`--write`).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectActionsPanel.renameTaken-26725.test.tsx` (new): rename to a taken name writes `call_api_2`, skips a taken suffix (`call_api_3`), free-name control writes as typed; each written draft parses through `ObjectSchema`.

## Acceptance notes

- Fixtures, examples and seeds: a JSON scan of the tracked tree found no object that repeats an action name (1292 files, 0 hits), and every `examples/**` stack already went through `defineStack`'s strict pass, which refused embedded twins before this change. The full spec, metadata-protocol and dogfood suites stayed green, so no TS fixture repeated one either.
- The local app-shell run was narrowed to the 169 test files that load the actions panel, the Studio design surface or the Data pillar (the 1,765-file package suite did not finish in 60 minutes on the shared box); CI's `Test UI` runs the rest.

## Verification

All readings on head `76f9014ff` (base `main` `c8583f80a`), on a shared container; the lock's VERDICT lines are quoted.

<details><summary>Reproduction before the fix (main c8583f80, pnpm dev:crm boot)</summary>

- `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/dup_item?mode=draft&package=com.qa.dup` with two actions named `dup` (labels "Dup A", "Dup B") → `200`, `Saved object 'dup_item' … state=draft`.
- `POST /api/v1/meta/object/dup_item/publish` → `200`, `Published draft`; the served object lists `dup/Dup A`, `dup/Dup B`.
- The standalone action door also saved an `action` named `dup` bound to the object (`200`): a second item, out of scope here (see What changes).
</details>

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` → Test Files 735 passed (735), Tests 22027 passed | 1 todo; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` green (tsc, scripts-typecheck, test-typecheck).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` → Test Files 270 passed | 3 skipped (273), Tests 21618 passed | 19 skipped. VERDICT command-exit 0.
- app-shell, narrowed to the 169 files that load `ObjectActionsPanel`, `StudioDesignSurface` or `DataPillar` → Test Files 169 passed (169), Tests 1349 passed; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` green. VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Dogfood battery, full (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`) → Test Files 314 passed | 3 skipped (317), Tests 2609 passed | 20 skipped. VERDICT command-exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restore proven blob == HEAD)</summary>

- Spec: the `refuseDuplicateActionNames(...)` call replaced by a no-op → `object-duplicate-action-name.test.ts` + `refused-shapes.test.ts`: Tests 5 failed | 74 passed. Restored.
- Studio: the rename guard's condition replaced by `false` → `ObjectActionsPanel.renameTaken-26725.test.tsx`: Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (the free-name control stays green). Restored.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 98 derived families, every one run and exit 0; `--ran` → `98 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 98 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- 89 of them ran on the tree of `fe0b8e175`; the only later commit, `76f9014ff`, adds the engine-double ledger rows, and the families it brought in plus `check:engine-double-contract` (red before `--write`, exit 0 after) were run on `76f9014ff`. `check:type-check-debt` first exited 3 (lock not granted while the test runs held it) and was re-run to exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` → `registered object-duplicate-action-name-refused (new here: object-duplicate-action-name-refused)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` → all 14 generated artifacts up to date.
</details>
